اقلعففتم (form IVq)
# اِقْلَعْفَفْتُمْ (iqlaʕfaftum) /iq.laʕ.faf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
# اُقْلُعْفِفْتُمْ (uqluʕfiftum) /uq.luʕ.fif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْلَعَفَّ (iqlaʕaffa)
